author: RaddicalAcid
quote: The MOST BORING Characters in any GTA, nothing edgy about them. For all those people who want GTA to be "realistic", if you met Jason in real life you would think he's the most boring, bland person to be around. No personality at all. As for Lucia shes a really basic woman with a fat butt who happens to do crime, nothing interesting about her at all. From what i've seen so far, the story and characters are a complete flop probably the worst story in GTA history. The thing carrying this game are the graphics and the fact that it has many of the GTA elements.
